results.detail: Summary matches the DTSX: SDK creates of gen_fundenrolment for automated joinings (status 2) and pension joinings with rejects; owner set by direct SQL (OwnerIdType 9 reject team, or 8 referent for passed-and-reject pension rows); pension joining linked by SQL; close step sets gen_enrolmentstatus=3; reject-management link via SDK; gen_ismailsend=0 for IDs in staging TblFundEnrolments. Config files at DTSX:16-17, [CRM]=Psql/ALTSHULER_MSCRM DTSX:4-6, staging DTSX:9-11, transfer flow Disabled DTSX:8160. Both CRM.Proxy and CRM2015.Proxy are referenced in the scripts.

Precedence constraints re-derived: Get Org Vars -> Create ETL (Constraint) -> Truncate (Constraint 1) -> Create Fundenrolment (Constraint 8) -> Pension (Constraint 2) -> Close (Constraint 4) -> Transfer [Disabled] (Constraint 5) -> Reject Mgmt (Constraint 6) -> Update FundEnrolment (Constraint 7) -> End ETL (Constraint 9). All have no Value attribute (=Success), LogicalAnd=True, no expressions. No event handlers. A disabled task does not block its successors.

Get Organization Variables reads gen_etlvariable (scope global or PackageName) and sets User::OrganizationName/ServerName/RejectTeamId. RejectTeamId later reaches CRM as the OwnerId of new Fund Enrolments, but that use is documented in the Create Fundenrolment/Pension claims (open[4], detailed[31]), and CLAUDE.md treats Organization Variables as plumbing. Create/End ETL Process only write gen_etlprocess. Truncate empties staging TblFundEnrolments (truncate step, plumbing per CLAUDE.md; its role is described under Update FundEnrolment). The three Derived Columns have no output columns and are dead-end sinks (Failure/Success sinks). None writes CRM business data or filters business rows.

results.detail: Source left joins gen_transferrequest on tr.gen_automatedjoining = aj.gen_automatedjoiningId (1:N); the other joins are 1:1 (agentcontract by id, productByCourse num = 1). Lookup CacheType=0 (full cache) is loaded before rows flow and has no visibility of FEs created in this run, so N rows lead to N creates. Frequency is labelled השערה.

Close Fund Enrolment Input0_ProcessInputRow has no try/catch around service.Update. An exception fails the component and the task, and Constraint 5/6/7 are Success-only, so Reject Mgmt linking and the gen_ismailsend update (and End ETL) do not run.
The WHERE has 'and pj.gen_joiningsource != 4 and pj.gen_fellowsignature != 2'. Under SQL three-valued logic, NULL in either column makes the predicate unknown and excludes the row.

Automated: gen_enrolmentstatus=1 only if !genclosedate_IsNull (main.cs:244-245). Pension: gen_ispension=true only if !gennewsletterapproval_IsNull (main.cs:284-285). Pension fullname = "" + " " + first + " " + last, so it has a leading space (main.cs:200-203).

The disabled flow's Insert To TemporaryTable does target '##TblFundEnrolments' on the [CRM] connection, not staging TblFundEnrolments. But the finding states unconditionally that, if enabled, the flow 'will record IDs in ##TblFundEnrolments in the CRM DB'. No step in the supplied files creates ##TblFundEnrolments, and a ## global temp table lives in tempdb on Psql, not in the ALTSHULER_MSCRM database. If the table does not exist at runtime, the OLE DB Command (errorRowDisposition=FailComponent) fails the data flow, and because of the Success chain, Update Reject Management and Update FundEnrolment would not run at all.

wrongUnits.problem: Unconditional runtime consequence and an inaccurate location ('in the CRM DB').
wrongUnits.correct: If enabled, the flow's IDs are inserted, via the [CRM] connection, into a global temp table ##TblFundEnrolments (tempdb on Psql) that no supplied step creates. They would never reach staging TblFundEnrolments, so they would not get gen_ismailsend=0. If the ## table does not exist, the insert fails (FailComponent), the data flow fails, and the following Success-chained steps do not run.
